say:2:1841116001:0.text: I never imagined I'd wind up living among the Graveborn—let alone with no memory of who I was.
say:2:1841116001:0.source_cn: 我以前从没想过，自己有一天竟然会来到亡灵的领地上生活，...

say:3:1841116002:1.text: And the worst part? I spent that whole time saying whatever came into my head around Estrilda...
say:3:1841116002:1.source_cn: 最重要的是，我竟然在失忆期间和爱丝说了那么多没轻没重的话……

choice_prompt:4:1841116002.text: And the worst part? I spent that whole time saying whatever came into my head around Estrilda...
choice_prompt:4:1841116002.source_cn: 最重要的是，我竟然在失忆期间和爱丝说了那么多没轻没重的话……

say:5:1841116003:0.source_cn: 啊……快别说了，简直太尴尬了！

say:6:1841116004:0.text: I spent years trying to be the calm, dependable older brother Estrilda could look up to. Now she's seen the real me.
say:6:1841116004:0.source_cn: 从前为了给爱丝树立榜样，我一直努力在她面前维持一位哥哥...

say:7:1841116005:0.text: Maybe Estrilda only failed to recognize "Rain" because you'd always hidden this side of yourself so well.
say:7:1841116005:0.source_cn: 就是因为你以前伪装得太好，爱丝才没有认出“里纳”就是你。

say:8:1841116006:1.text: If she'd figured it out sooner, we might have had you back sooner.
say:8:1841116006:1.source_cn: 如果她早点知道，或许我们还能更早些团聚。

say:9:1841116007:1.text: She was already at death's door because of the candle blossoms. If she'd learned then that "Rain" was me—and that I didn't remember her at all—it could've broken her. Her condition might have gotten even worse...
say:9:1841116007:1.source_cn: 她当时被赤烛蕊寄生，生命垂危，要是再在那种情况下知道我...

say:10:1841116008:1.text: So I'm glad she didn't recognize me.
say:10:1841116008:1.source_cn: 所以我很庆幸，她没认出我。

say:11:1841116009:1.text: Estrilda is stronger than you think.
say:11:1841116009:1.source_cn: 爱丝远比你想象得更坚强。

say:12:1841116010:1.text: She's grown up a lot in the years you've been gone.
say:12:1841116010:1.source_cn: 你不在的这几年里，她成长了很多。

say:14:1841116012:1.text: And that's all thanks to you, Thane.
say:14:1841116012:1.source_cn: 这一切都要感谢你，瑟恩。

say:16:1841116014:1.text: Actually, there's one more favor I need. Do this, and I'll owe you forever!
say:16:1841116014:1.source_cn: 话说回来，如果你能办到另一件事，我会更加感激你！

say:17:1841116015:1.text: Help me win back some dignity in Estrilda's eyes!
say:17:1841116015:1.source_cn: ——帮我挽回我在爱丝心里的形象！

say:19:1841116017:1.text: Have you seen the way she looks at me now? It's like she just heard the most dignified elder in the family swear for the first time!
say:19:1841116017:1.source_cn: 你没觉得她现在看我的眼神都有点奇怪吗？那种表情——那种...

say:20:1841116018:1.text: ... That can't be fixed. Give up.

say:21:1841116019:1.text: Don't give up on me that quickly! At least try!
say:21:1841116019:1.source_cn: 不要这么快拒绝啊！至少也试一试吧！

choice:4:0:1.text: You mean all the things you blurted out without thinking?
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 你是指你的口无遮拦吗？
choice:4:0:1.male: You mean all the things you blurted out without thinking?
choice:4:0:1.female: You mean all the things you blurted out without thinking?

choice:4:1:2.text: You did say becoming Graveborn wasn't so bad.
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 确实，你还说变成亡灵也不错
choice:4:1:2.male: You did say becoming Graveborn wasn't so bad.
choice:4:1:2.female: You did say becoming Graveborn wasn't so bad.
